csharp_preferred_modifier_order #

The order modifiers are written in. ⚠ Measured 2026-08-29 against jb cleanupcode 2025.2.6, one key flipped at a time over the export in an appended [*.cs] section — the sweep's own method — and classified wrong subsystem — the arranger's. ⚠ The unprefixed-spelling claim is refuted here: the C# side does read this key. Flat under CSReformatCode; under the cleanup profile three orderings produce three distinct outputs, because SortModifiers performs it. So it wants an .arranged.expected.cs fixture and a place in ArrangementOptions.Implemented, not a formatter fixture.
